summary: Order-book reads Groww refuses: a refused CASH list fails the poll, which publishes nothing and keeps its baseline; a refused FNO list beside a good CASH list is skipped; the open order the next good read finds is relayed against the baseline from before the failures.

notes: The refusal is Groww's documented failure envelope, the body the web's own test uses for a refused request (test_groww_review_fixes.py:48), answered with HTTP 200 so that only its status field says it failed, as _get_paged and orders.rs paged both read it.

Web: a CASH list that fails makes direct_get_order_book return an error before the FNO list is read (order_api.py:139-145), get_orderbook_with_auth answers not success, and _poll_loop logs it and keeps its baseline (order_adapter.py:476-479); an FNO list that fails is skipped (order_api.py:146). Each answer the case serves is one poll of the web's own loop (web_adapters/groww.py through polling.py).

Desktop: orders.rs raw_orders returns the same error for a refused CASH list and skips a refused FNO one; common/order_poll.rs keeps its snapshot across a failed read and polls again after a backoff (2 s after one failure at the case's 1 s interval; the web polls at its interval). The backoff changes when the next read comes, not what it publishes.

deviations.reason: The web relays pending_quantity 0 for a working order: its Groww order book has no pending quantity. The desktop sends Groww's remaining_quantity.
